credito: YouTube: Container Ship Dashcam - Around The World In 70 Days (Timelapse, 4k, 60fps) – View/save archived versions on archive.org
descricao:
Over 250,000 combined over a 70 day period documenting the voyage of a neopanamax container ship. 
The route starts at Hong Kong in mid-November 2017, and is a circular route continuously sailing east. 
There are a few compression artifacts (glitchiness) that I have been unable to remove.
